PROJECTS 
Reunify – AI-Powered Missing Person Finder (2025) (Team Project): 
Built a disaster-response web app using facial recognition to reunite missing individuals with families. 
Integrated ML model with FastAPI and MongoDB and helped deploy a Telegram bot for real-time 
volunteer alerts. 
Tech Stack: Vue.js, FastAPI, MongoDB, Machine Learning, Telegram Bot API 
Legal Document Analyzer (HackrX 2025) (Team Project): 
Developed an RAG system to extract insights from legal documents using natural language queries. 
Implemented query parsing, semantic search via vector DB, and structured output generation with a open- 
source LLM—prioritizing affordability and transparency. 
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Chroma, Llama/OSS-120b LLM, NLP Libraries 
Smart Wheelchair – Gesture-Controlled Navigation (2025) (Team Project): 
Developed a smart wheelchair prototype controlled through hand gestures using Mediapipe and OpenCV. 
Integrated the system with an ESP32 microcontroller to translate gestures into movement commands. 
Contributed to software development, hardware interfacing, and testing for real-time performance. 
Tech Stack: Python, OpenCV, Mediapipe, ESP32, Serial Communication
